description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain that prides itself on fresh-made dough from 100% Canadian wheat, organic tomato sauce, and meats raised without antibiotics or added hormones. This Vancouver Island location offers takeout and delivery pizza with a broad plant-based menu including vegan and vegetarian options. It is a practical calorie stop for touring cyclists moving through the area.
